summary.short: Amends Japan's Information Processing Promotion Act and Special Accounts Act to add designation of high-speed information processing semiconductors, public selection of operators to produce them, and state-backed bond, fund and guarantee financing for advanced semiconductor and AI-related technology, mainly for Reiwa 7 to 12 fiscal years.
summary.long: Act No. 30 of 2025 amends the Act on Promotion of Information Processing (Act No. 90 of 1970) and the Special Accounts Act. It adds a chapter under which the Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry may designate high-speed information processing semiconductors by cabinet-order category and must publish the designation. It adds a chapter on advanced semiconductor and AI-related technology in which the Minister publicly solicits and selects operators for production facilities, trial production and demand development, with plans that require submission, ministerial approval for changes, and reporting duties. The Independent Administrative Agency for Information-technology Promotion (IPA) may provide capital contributions, bond and loan guarantees and interest subsidies, and may issue bonds or borrow under ministerial approval. The government may issue bonds and provide guarantees, and the energy special account is used for these measures, with fiscal authority limits per fiscal year stated in the text. Related tax provisions reduce registration tax and adjust business tax for selected operators. Fines apply for failure to report. The Act takes effect on a date set by cabinet order within three months of promulgation, and includes a five-year review clause.
